retro:
# PR 12780 retrospective

## What worked

- Fresh verified reviewer sessions, equivalent neutral scope, separate report/fixture directories, and no peer conclusions until both finals were saved maintained independent investigation.
- The production scanner could be tested completely offline against synthetic files, without requesting a desktop slot or touching a real account.
- Both reviewers independently demonstrated the head test passes on the correction and fails on the baseline. Exact outputs and inner exit codes made this stronger than an outer runner success status.
- A small baseline/head table explains the successful correction without inventing a finding or generic test request.
- Coordinator source inspection and separate string/path fixture resolved plausible concerns without prescribing reviewer conclusions.

## Avoidable friction and improvements

- Each reviewer copied a large standalone Node binary for the existing JavaScript part of the shell test. This followed supported tooling and retained provenance, but duplicated evidence storage. Batch related cases in one sealed run where practical. Do not trade away the complete authored test without clearly narrowing claims.
- Fable's pathlib construction normalized an intended `/.` input. Preserve unusual path spellings as raw strings and check the actual executed argument. Independent Astra and coordinator runs covered that spelling correctly.
- Fable's wrapper always exits zero, recording the child status separately. It was correctly interpreted in synthesis, but wrappers that explicitly assert expected child outcomes reduce future handoff ambiguity.
- Source/document research is authorized separately from runtime networking. Astra conservatively did no external research; this did not block the filesystem contract review.

## Tool issues

No confirmed review.py or Omadev bug. Missing Node on the sandbox PATH is a documented capability limitation, not an Omarchy defect. No Omadev nest was used and no desktop issue can be inferred.

## Cleanup and carry-forward

Reviewers completed normally. Private homes and synthetic trees were removed with sandbox teardown; no daemon or background service was started. No desktop slot was claimed. Source worktrees, fixture binaries, raw evidence and session identities are intentionally retained. Preserve historical artifacts when resetting this team's reviewers for a future assignment, only after outer publication verification. Do not reset this coordinator or select another PR within this assignment.

Use a clean scoped public outcome with live-sync, UI and performance limits. Do not convert untested integration boundaries or intentionally preserved nested names into generic advice. Final editorial checks must use the exact draft in a new Astra Medium session and remain distinct from technical evidence verification.
